verses.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Happy is every one that feareth the LORD, That walketh in His ways.

verses.he: יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּיךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: When thou eatest the labour of thy hands, Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.he: אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤׀ כְּגֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֪י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, round about thy table.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Behold, surely thus shall the man be blessed That feareth the LORD.

verses.he: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהוָ֗ה מִצִּ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭רְאֵה בְּט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלָ֑‍ִם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: The LORD bless thee out of Zion; And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life;
And see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel!
